description: This file defines the Dispatcher class and related classes for managing test execution, worker processes, and test result reporting in a test runner environment, specifically for Playwright's test framework.

classes.name: Dispatcher
classes.description: Manages test execution, worker pool, and scheduling in the test runner.

classes.name: JobDispatcher
classes.description: Handles individual test group execution, test lifecycle events, and retries.

methods.name: _findFirstJobToRun
methods.description: Finds the first test group in the queue that can be scheduled respecting worker limits.

methods.name: _scheduleJob
methods.description: Schedules the next test group to run if resources are available.

methods.name: _runJobInWorker
methods.description: Runs a test group in a specific worker, managing worker lifecycle and test execution.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Starts the test execution process with a list of test groups and environment variables.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all workers and halts test execution.

methods.name: producedEnvByProjectId
methods.description: Returns environment variables produced by workers, keyed by project ID.
